(Well-known problem). Let W ∗ (Fk ) denote the von Neumann algebra of the
free group of rank k ∈ {2, 3, . . . , ℵ0 }. Is W ∗ (Fk ) isomorphic to W ∗ (Fl ) for k ̸= l?
    For a group G, recall that W ∗ (G) is an appropriate completion of the group algebra
CG (see e. g. S. Sakai, C ∗ -algebras and W ∗ -algebras, Springer, 1971, in particular
Problem 4.4.44). It is known that either W ∗ (Fk ) ∼    = W ∗ (Fl ) for all k, l ∈ {2, 3, . . . , ℵ0 },
               ∗
or that the W (Fk ) are pairwise non-isomorphic (F. Radulescu, Invent. Math., 115
(1994), 347–389, Corollary 4.7).                                                  P. de la Harpe
